nom: Bubble Cloud Surf Water Cream Moisturizer

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the moisturizer controls shine and keeps skin from feeling greasy over the day, with several calling it their best match for oily skin; one found it too watery and unhelpful for oil control.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it hydrates well as a lighter daytime option, though one found it evaporates within minutes and leaves skin dry again.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combo-dry and sensitive-acne-prone variants, report good hydration without stickiness and no breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report no irritation and even recommend it for sensitive skin, but others describe itching, a rash on the jaw and neck, or repeated lip bumps traced to the product.
segments.normal: One reviewer who describes having had normal skin before developing hormonal acne switched to this moisturizer and reports it absorbs well and doesn't clog pores.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the product hydrates well and leaves skin glowing or dewy without greasiness; one reviewer reports it feels moisturizing on application but evaporates within minutes leaving skin dry again.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin who cannot use several common actives reports the product improved acne and smoothed texture but caused repeated irritation bumps on the lips, confirmed by a dermatologist visit.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or oily-acne skin report no new breakouts and even clearer skin; two reviewers report the product broke them out, one specifically attributing it to triggered fungal acne.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily skin report it balances oil and prevents a greasy look through the day; one reviewer says it felt greasy and did not reduce oil.

aspects.libelle: Fun pump dispenses too much product
Feels greasy or heavy on skin

The layout of my skin is as follows: dry, sensitive, acne prone. What I CANT use: PGA, HA, AHA's, Niacinamide, Shea Butter. After thorough research, I bought this product. I've been using this product for exactly 22 days (April 6th 2025). Within these 22 days my skin had had a massive improvement with my acne. Skin texture is smoother and more even. HOWEVER, something in this product is irritating my lips horrendously. Within the past 22 days I've had 4 irritation bumps appear just on my lips. After the first one appeared on April 15th, I immediately scheduled a visit with my dermatologist fearing the bump was something more sinister. Everything sinister was ruled out. She stated that it was likely a fordyce spot or a bump from something irritating my lip. At the time, I didnt equate the bump to the moisturizer. It went away after 5 days. But then another one appeared just two days later and I was at a loss. Ive NEVER had any issues with my Lips. I couldnt understand why all of the sudden my lips looked like that. Terrified, i cautiously put on this moisturizer in the morning, avoiding my lips, and I havent had any appear for a week and a half. Yesterday, in a rush I applied this moisturizer and forgot to be careful around my lips. I woke up this morning with TWO bumps on my lips… unfortunately confirming that this product is the culprit of the bumps. I will be returning.

I have acne prone skin and always look for lightweight moisturizers that won't make me too oily or break me out. this moisturizer is fragrance free and doesn't clog my pores. leaves skin with a nice, dewy look without being heavy or sticky. just taking one star off because it's almost too lightweight and feels more like a toner than a moisturizer!

extraits.titre: Good moisturizer, just not for me
extraits.texte: I loved how light ans creamy this moisterizer was! It felt creamy, but not in a heavy way, which is what I was looking for. Unfortunately, this product triggered my fungal acne :(, but if you dont struggle with that you would probably like it.

I randomly came across this browsing through the store. I have the most acne prone skin you can have & every moisturizer I use ends up clogging my pores. I have been using this for over a week now & my skin loves it. I wish it came in a jumbo size!!

I have pretty dry skin, but bought this to use as a daytime moisturizer (in the warner months) so I wouldn't look so greasy using my nighttime moisturizer. I apply it over a vitamin C serum and my skin feels nicely hydrated without looking too shiny. I've never used an applicator like this, but I do like it. A little goes a long way, so dispense a little bit at a time! I also love the packaging

extraits.titre: Perfect balance and hydration for combo-dry, acne-prone skin
extraits.texte: I have purchased and used up several bottles of this moisturizer, and it is the perfect balance for my combo-dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin. It hydrates and soothes my skin, without clogging my pores or making my face feel greasy. I highly recommend this to other folks who find that lightweight gels/lotions are not enough, but heavy creams are too much.
